the following questions: How to apply the SDN principles to the home network?

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are proposing a solution to interconnect smart environments in a simple and flexible way, while keeping users in control of their networks.

we are trying to bring together the SDN principles and the smart environment concepts in order to build a software-based, programmable, and flexible solution that can be applied in any kind of smart environment.
we propose a solution that enables the control of a smart environment network to the user, while keeping the network management and control in the hands of the network administrator.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SDN is a promising approach for interconnecting the many devices of interconnected smart environments.

SDN principles can be applied to a wide variety of smart environments to enable the interconnection of devices according to the services users are expecting, and that the SD-LAN architecture is a good candidate for such applications.
SDN is an enabler to provide end-users of smart environments with the ability to control their networks, while keeping a high level of security and privacy.
